# Consul ECS 0.10.x

## Release highlights

- **Consul 2.0 support:** Consul on ECS 0.10.x supports Consul 2.0.x, in addition to Consul 1.21.x and 1.22.x. Refer to the [Consul on ECS compatibility matrix](/consul/docs/upgrade/ecs) for details.

- **Outlier detection settings (0.10.0):** The `service.networkResilienceConfig.outlierDetection` block in the `ECS_CONFIG_JSON` configuration supports the `consecutive5xx`, `enforcingConsecutiveGatewayFailure`, and `maxEjectionPercent` fields. Use them to detect gateway failures and to control the percentage of upstream instances that Envoy ejects through passive health checks. Refer to [passive health checks](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/service-defaults#upstreamconfig-defaults-passivehealthcheck) for more information.

- **Health sync improvements (0.10.0):** The `health-sync` command applies health check statuses for all registered containers, including the `consul-dataplane` container, and writes them to Consul in a single catalog registration request.

- **FIPS 140-3 (0.10.1):** FIPS builds of Consul on ECS use the Go Cryptographic Module, which holds FIPS 140-3 certificate #5247, instead of FIPS 140-2 BoringCrypto. Refer to [Deploy FIPS 140-3 compliant Consul servers](/consul/docs/deploy/server/fips) for more information.

- **Security updates (0.10.1):** Consul on ECS 0.10.1 is built with Go 1.26.8 and includes dependency upgrades that address CVEs.

## Upgrade notes

- **FIPS artifact names changed in 0.10.1.** FIPS 140-3 builds use the `fips1403` suffix instead of `fips1402`. If you pin FIPS artifacts, update the version metadata from `+fips1402` to `+fips1403` and the container image tag from `-fips1402` to `-fips1403`. For example, use the `public.ecr.aws/hashicorp/consul-ecs-fips:0.10.1-fips1403` image.

- Use the matching version of the [Consul ECS Terraform modules](https://registry.terraform.io/modules/hashicorp/consul-ecs/aws/latest). The `consul-ecs` binary and the Terraform modules are tightly coupled. For example, use the `consul-ecs` 0.10.1 binary with the 0.10.1 Terraform modules.

## Supported software versions

- Consul: 1.21.x, 1.22.x, 2.0.x
- Consul ECS Terraform modules: 0.10.x
